CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_reliability_private.pending_planning_cents(p_operation icash_operation_spend)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when p_operation.state not in ('reserved','dispatched') then 0
  when exists(select 1 from icash_reliability_private.pending_work_relief r
   join icash_reliability_private.pending_work_relief_policy p on p.id=1 and p.enabled
   where r.operation_key=p_operation.operation_key and r.account_id=p_operation.account_id
    and r.operation_snapshot=to_jsonb(p_operation)-'estimate_checked_at') then 0
  when exists(select 1 from icash_reliability_private.pending_work_relief_20261113 r
   join icash_reliability_private.pending_work_relief_policy_20261113 p on p.id=1 and p.enabled
   where r.operation_key=p_operation.operation_key and r.account_id=p_operation.account_id
    and r.operation_snapshot=to_jsonb(p_operation)-'estimate_checked_at') then 0
  else p_operation.charge_cap_cents end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_work_private.warm_seller_due(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from icash_work_private.value_priority_settings where id and enabled) then return false; end if;
 if exists (
  select 1 from public.icash_text_ai_jobs j
  join public.icash_text_threads t on t.id=j.thread_id and t.account_id=j.account_id
  join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id
  join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=d.screening_id and s.account_id=d.account_id
  join public.icash_text_messages m on m.id=j.message_id and m.thread_id=t.id and m.account_id=t.account_id
  where j.account_id=p_account and j.state in ('pending','drafted') and j.next_attempt_at<=now() and j.outgoing_id is null
   and m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and coalesce(nullif(m.provider_id,''),nullif(m.event_id,'')) is not null
   and m.created_at<=now() and greatest(m.created_at,j.next_attempt_at) between now()-interval '5 minutes' and now()
   and t.party='seller' and t.ai_mode='auto' and not t.paused and not t.manual_only and t.retired_at is null
   and coalesce(t.eligibility_until,t.permission_until)>now() and coalesce(d.terms->>'practice','false')<>'true'
   and public.icash_seller_response_disposition(m.body) is null
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions x where x.phone=t.recipient)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_suppressions x where x.contact_key=encode(sha256(convert_to(t.recipient,'UTF8')),'hex'))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls x where x.account_id=p_account and x.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and x.manual)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_seller_reply_progress r where r.message_id=m.id and r.account_id=p_account and r.state<>'pending')
 ) then return true; end if;
 if exists (
  select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs j join public.icash_voice_contact_targets v on v.account_id=j.account_id and v.id=coalesce(j.permission_id,j.operational_contact_id)
  join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=v.screening_id and s.account_id=v.account_id
  where j.account_id=p_account and j.state='ready' and (j.callback_id is not null or j.sms_source_message_id is not null)
   and j.due_at between now()-interval '5 minutes' and now() and j.provider_call_sid is null and j.operation_key is null
   and v.party='seller' and v.revoked_at is null and v.permission_until>now() and v.dnc_clear
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions x where x.phone=v.phone)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_suppressions x where x.contact_key=v.contact_key)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls x where x.account_id=p_account and x.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and x.manual)
   and public.icash_voice_outreach_hours_current(p_account,j.id)
 ) then return coalesce(public.icash_outgoing_voice_capacity_open(),false); end if;
 return false;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_admin_plan_mode(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p.plan from public.icash_admin_plans p
 join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=p.account_id and a.owner_user_id=p.user_id
 where p.account_id=p_account
 and (a.billing_model<>'membership_credits' or exists(select 1 from public.icash_memberships m
  where m.account_id=a.id and m.mode='live' and m.state='active' and m.paid_through>now()))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_call_has_seller_response(p_result jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(p_result->'transcript')='array' then p_result->'transcript' else '[]'::jsonb end) t
 where t->>'role'='user' and not public.icash_call_is_automated_menu(t->>'message') and (
  case when t->>'message' ~ '[[:alpha:]]'
   and t->>'message' !~* '^\s*[\[(*]?\s*(music( playing)?|silence|noise|background noise|inaudible|unintelligible|no speech|no audio)\s*[\])*]?\s*[.!]*\s*$'
   and t->>'message' !~* 'leave (a |an |your )?((additional|brief|short) )?message|record (a |your )?message|(at|after) the (sound of the )?(beep|tone)|mailbox (is|has)|voicemail (for|system)|has been disconnected|number you (have )?dialed|^\s*(?:please )?leave (?:your|a) name (?:and|&) (?:number|message)(?:[, .]+(?:and )?i[''’]ll (?:call you back|get back to you)(?: as soon as possible)?)?[.! ]*$|^\s*[. ]*(?:google )?voice will try to connect you[.! ]*$|^\s*(?:one|two|1|2)[, ]+to connect your call[.! ]*$|^\s*(?:gracias[.! ]+)?permane(?:ce|zca) en la l[ií]nea[.! ]*$|^\s*(?:lo siento[.,! ]+)?esta persona no est[aá] disponible[.! ]*$|press any key to continue|^\s*(?:an? )?ai assistant recording this call for the person|^\s*please try your call again later[.! ]+(?:goodbye[.! ]*)?$|press (one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|zero|pound|star|[0-9#*])|automated (voice|system)|please (stay|hold|remain) on the line|please (say|state) your name|screening (this|your) call|call has been forwarded|cannot take your call|can.t take your call|when you( have|[’'']ve|ve) finished recording|^\s*(stay|hold|remain) on the line[.! ]*$|this person is not available|press the (pound|star|[0-9#*]) key|^\s*[. ]*(?:(?:when (?:that.s|you.ve|you have)|have) )?finish(?:ed)? recording[,. ]+you may hang up|^\s*[. ]*recording[, ]+you may hang up|^\s*to end recording[.! ]*$|^\s*this is a recorded message[.! ]|^\s*[¿]?(?:puedes|puede|pueden) colgar cuando hayas? terminado de grabar(?:lo)?|(?:graba|grabe|deja|deje) (?:tu|su|un) mensaje despu[eé]s (?:del tono|de la se[ñn]al)|^\s*deje despu[eé]s del tono|^\s*no se ha grabado nada[.! ]|^\s*[0-9 -]{4,16} is not available[.! ]*$'
   and (t->>'message' !~* '^\s*(?:at the (?:beep|beach)[.! ,]*thank you|[. ]*(?:(?:(?:i[''’]ll )?(?:see|check)) if )?(?:this )?person is available|[¿]?esta persona est[aá] disponible[?]?)[.! ,]*$' or not exists(
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'transcript') machine
    where machine->>'role'='user' and machine->>'message' ~* 'leave (a |an |your )?((additional|brief|short) )?message|record (a |your )?message|(at|after) the (sound of the )?(beep|tone)|mailbox (is|has)|voicemail (for|system)|has been disconnected|number you (have )?dialed|^\s*(?:please )?leave (?:your|a) name (?:and|&) (?:number|message)(?:[, .]+(?:and )?i[''’]ll (?:call you back|get back to you)(?: as soon as possible)?)?[.! ]*$|^\s*[. ]*(?:google )?voice will try to connect you[.! ]*$|^\s*(?:one|two|1|2)[, ]+to connect your call[.! ]*$|^\s*(?:gracias[.! ]+)?permane(?:ce|zca) en la l[ií]nea[.! ]*$|^\s*(?:lo siento[.,! ]+)?esta persona no est[aá] disponible[.! ]*$|press any key to continue|^\s*(?:an? )?ai assistant recording this call for the person|^\s*please try your call again later[.! ]+(?:goodbye[.! ]*)?$|press (one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|zero|pound|star|[0-9#*])|automated (voice|system)|please (stay|hold|remain) on the line|please (say|state) your name|screening (this|your) call|call has been forwarded|cannot take your call|can.t take your call|when you( have|[’'']ve|ve) finished recording|^\s*(stay|hold|remain) on the line[.! ]*$|this person is not available|press the (pound|star|[0-9#*]) key|^\s*[. ]*(?:(?:when (?:that.s|you.ve|you have)|have) )?finish(?:ed)? recording[,. ]+you may hang up|^\s*[. ]*recording[, ]+you may hang up|^\s*to end recording[.! ]*$|^\s*this is a recorded message[.! ]|^\s*[¿]?(?:puedes|puede|pueden) colgar cuando hayas? terminado de grabar(?:lo)?|(?:graba|grabe|deja|deje) (?:tu|su|un) mensaje despu[eé]s (?:del tono|de la se[ñn]al)|^\s*deje despu[eé]s del tono|^\s*no se ha grabado nada[.! ]|^\s*[0-9 -]{4,16} is not available[.! ]*$')) then true
   else public.icash_seller_response_disposition(t->>'message')='opt_out' end));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_cancellation_voice_current(p_account uuid, p_operation text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs j join public.icash_voice_contact_targets p on p.id=coalesce(j.permission_id,j.operational_contact_id) and p.account_id=j.account_id
 join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=j.account_id and not a.bot_paused
 join public.icash_voice_configs cfg on cfg.account_id=a.id and cfg.enabled and cfg.reviewed_until>now()
 where j.account_id=p_account and 'voice:'||j.id=p_operation and j.cancellation_notice_id is not null
 and public.icash_cancellation_voice_context(p_account,j.id) is not null and p.party='seller' and p.revoked_at is null and p.permission_until>now()
 and (public.icash_seller_voice_permission_current(p_account,p.id) or (p.dnc_clear and p.dnc_checked_at between now()-interval '30 days' and now()))
 and (j.operational_contact_id is null or public.icash_operational_contact_current(p_account,j.operational_contact_id,'voice',false))
 and exists(select 1 from pg_timezone_names where name=p.timezone)

 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions where phone=p.phone)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_suppressions where contact_key=p.contact_key));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_claim_inventory(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare l public.icash_seller_intakes;s public.icash_screening_jobs;
begin
 select lead.* into l from public.icash_seller_intakes lead
 join public.icash_seller_matches m on m.lead_id=lead.id
 where m.account_id=p_account and m.screening_id=p_screening for share of lead;
 if not found then return public.icash_claim_cold_inventory(p_account,p_screening,p_phone);end if;
 select * into s from public.icash_screening_jobs where id=p_screening and account_id=p_account for share;
 if not found or s.state<>'complete' or l.state<>'assigned'
  or p_phone is null or p_phone !~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$' or p_phone is distinct from l.phone
  or l.property->>'id' is null or s.snapshot->>'propertyId' is distinct from l.property->>'id'
  or s.snapshot->'sellerRequest'->>'id' is distinct from l.id::text
  or s.snapshot->'sellerRequest'->>'phone' is distinct from l.phone
  or public.icash_seller_contact_evidence(p_account,p_screening,l.id,p_phone) is null then return false;end if;
 if exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions where phone=p_phone)
  or exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_suppressions where contact_key=encode(sha256(convert_to(p_phone,'UTF8')),'hex'))
  or exists(select 1 from public.icash_outbound_property_owners where property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and account_id<>p_account)
  or exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls where account_id=p_account and property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and manual)
  or exists(select 1 from public.icash_handoffs where account_id=p_account and screening_id=p_screening and state<>'resolved') then return false;end if;
 -- A different buyer's completed purchase ends this buyer's outreach. The
 -- winning buyer may continue its own permitted contract/closing conversation.
 if exists(select 1 from public.icash_seller_matches m
  join public.icash_deal_files d on d.account_id=m.account_id and d.screening_id=m.screening_id
  join public.icash_signing_envelopes e on e.account_id=d.account_id and e.deal_id=d.id
  where m.lead_id=l.id and m.account_id<>p_account and e.kind='purchase' and not e.test_mode and e.state='completed') then return false;end if;
 return true;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_claim_owner_enrichment(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_operation text, p_snapshot jsonb, p_rate uuid, p_credit_cap integer, p_unit_cost_micros bigint, p_quoted_data_cost_micros bigint, p_rights_until timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare approval public.icash_owner_enrichment_recoveries;
begin
 perform 1 from public.icash_operating_budget where id=1 for update;
 select * into approval from public.icash_owner_enrichment_recoveries where operation_key=p_operation;
 if found and (approval.account_id is distinct from p_account or approval.screening_id is distinct from p_screening
  or not exists(select 1 from public.icash_screening_jobs s where s.id=p_screening and s.account_id=p_account
   and public.icash_owner_enrichment_screening_hash(s)=approval.expected_screening_hash)
  or not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend o join public.icash_credit_reservations cr on cr.id=o.credit_reservation_id
   join public.icash_operation_rates r on r.id=o.rate_id where o.operation_key=p_operation and o.account_id=p_account and o.rate_id=p_rate
   and cr.account_id=p_account and cr.operation_key=p_operation and cr.amount_cents<=approval.approved_max_charge_cents
   and r.operation='owner_enrichment' and r.charge_cents<=approval.approved_max_charge_cents and o.charge_cap_cents<=approval.approved_max_charge_cents)) then return false;end if;
 return public.icash_claim_owner_before_recovery_cap(p_account,p_screening,p_operation,p_snapshot,p_rate,p_credit_cap,p_unit_cost_micros,p_quoted_data_cost_micros,p_rights_until);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_customer_text_operation(p_account uuid, p_operation text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_messages m join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=m.account_id
 where m.account_id=p_account and 'text:'||m.id=p_operation and m.customer_author_id=a.owner_user_id and m.direction='outgoing' and m.state in ('ready','dispatching')
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_ai_jobs j where j.outgoing_id=m.id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_general_reception_pause_exempt(p_account uuid, p_operation text, p_charge bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from icash_reception_private.receipts r
 join icash_reception_private.config c on c.id=1 and c.account_id=r.account_id
 join public.icash_operation_rates rate on rate.id=c.rate_id
 where p_account=c.account_id and r.operation_key=p_operation
  and r.operation_key='reception:'||r.call_sid and r.admission_xid=txid_current()
  and r.state='reserved' and r.conversation_id is null and r.config_hash=c.config_hash
  and r.agent_id=c.agent_id and r.branch_id=c.branch_id and r.reviewed_version_id=c.reviewed_version_id
  and c.enabled and c.allow_inbound_while_paused and c.inbound_pause_approval_reference is not null
  and r.call_profile=c.call_profile and r.rate_id=c.rate_id
  and r.max_duration_seconds=c.max_duration_seconds and r.customer_charge_cap_cents=c.customer_charge_cap_cents
  and (c.call_profile='normal' or (c.call_profile='owner_quick_test' and c.owner_quick_test_enabled
   and c.owner_quick_test_approval_reference is not null and r.caller_hash=c.owner_caller_hash))
  and c.approved_at<=clock_timestamp()
  and c.reviewed_until>=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>c.max_duration_seconds+60)
  and rate.operation='incoming_call' and rate.enabled and rate.charge_cents=c.customer_charge_cap_cents
  and p_charge=c.customer_charge_cap_cents and rate.voice_max_duration_seconds=c.max_duration_seconds
  and rate.verified_at<=clock_timestamp()
  and rate.expires_at>=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>c.max_duration_seconds+60)
  and (not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend o where o.operation_key=p_operation)
   or exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend o where o.operation_key=p_operation
    and o.account_id=c.account_id and o.rate_id=c.rate_id and o.charge_cap_cents=c.customer_charge_cap_cents)));

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_limited_seller_voice(p_account uuid, p_operation text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs j join public.icash_contact_permissions p on p.id=j.permission_id and p.account_id=j.account_id
 where j.account_id=p_account and 'voice:'||j.id=p_operation and j.callback_id is null and j.state in ('ready','issued','dispatching')
 and p.party='seller' and public.icash_seller_voice_permission_current(p_account,p.id) and public.icash_seller_limited_contact(p_account,p.screening_id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_membership_work_allowed(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.icash_accounts a where a.id=p_account and (a.billing_model<>'membership_credits' or exists(select 1 from public.icash_memberships m where m.account_id=a.id and m.mode='live' and m.state='active' and m.paid_through>now())))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_meta_contact_only(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_phone text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.icash_meta_leads m join public.icash_seller_intakes l on l.id=m.lead_id join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=m.screening_id and s.account_id=m.account_id
 where m.account_id=p_account and m.screening_id=p_screening and l.phone=p_phone and s.state='awaiting_address'
 and public.icash_seller_contact_evidence(m.account_id,m.screening_id,m.lead_id,l.phone) is not null);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_meta_followup_current(p_lead uuid, p_step text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(
  select 1 from public.icash_meta_leads m join public.icash_seller_intakes l on l.id=m.lead_id
  join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=m.account_id
  where m.lead_id=p_lead and p_step in ('followup_1','followup_2','call')
   and not m.paused and m.declined_at is null and m.response_at is null and m.address_confirmed_at is null
   and l.state='awaiting_address' and l.canonical_id is null and l.contact_consent_scope is distinct from 'icash_x_demo'
   and m.contact_until>now() and m.first_outreach_at>now()-interval '72 hours'
   and m.first_outreach_at<=now()-case p_step when 'followup_1' then interval '15 minutes' when 'call' then interval '2 hours' else interval '24 hours' end
   and not a.bot_paused and public.icash_membership_work_allowed(a.id)
   and exists(select 1 from public.icash_wallets w where w.account_id=a.id and w.balance_cents>0)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_threads t join public.icash_text_messages msg on msg.thread_id=t.id and msg.account_id=t.account_id
    where t.seller_intake_id=m.lead_id and t.account_id=m.account_id and msg.direction='incoming' and msg.state='received')
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations c where c.account_id=m.account_id and c.screening_id=m.screening_id and c.state in ('waiting','review'))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_call_recordings r where r.account_id=m.account_id and r.screening_id=m.screening_id and r.call_ended_at is null
    and not (r.state in ('declined','failed','absent') and public.icash_voice_attempt_recorded(r.voice_job_id)))
   and exists(select 1 from public.icash_meta_lead_messages mm join public.icash_text_messages msg on msg.id=mm.message_id
    where mm.lead_id=m.lead_id and mm.purpose='initial' and msg.account_id=m.account_id and msg.state in ('accepted','delivered') and msg.provider_id is not null)
   and (p_step<>'followup_2' or exists(select 1 from public.icash_meta_lead_messages mm join public.icash_text_messages msg on msg.id=mm.message_id
    where mm.lead_id=m.lead_id and mm.purpose='followup_1' and msg.state in ('accepted','delivered') and msg.provider_id is not null and msg.updated_at<=now()-interval '6 hours'))
   and (p_step<>'call' or (not m.voice_paused and exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs j
    where j.id=m.voice_job_id and j.account_id=m.account_id and public.icash_voice_attempt_recorded(j.id)
     and exists(select 1 from public.icash_call_recordings first_call
      where first_call.voice_job_id=j.id and first_call.account_id=j.account_id
       and first_call.call_sid is not null and first_call.dial_claimed_at<=now()-interval '2 hours')
     and (j.conversation_id is null or exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations c
      where c.account_id=j.account_id and c.conversation_id=j.conversation_id and c.state='complete' and c.completed_at is not null
       and public.icash_meta_call_outcome(c.result)='no_response')))))
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_meta_voice_context(p_account uuid, p_job uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('leadId',m.lead_id,'name',l.name,'state',l.state,'address',l.address)
 from public.icash_voice_jobs j join public.icash_contact_permissions p on p.id=j.permission_id and p.account_id=j.account_id
 join public.icash_meta_leads m on m.lead_id=p.seller_intake_id and m.account_id=p.account_id and m.screening_id=p.screening_id
 join public.icash_seller_intakes l on l.id=m.lead_id
 where j.account_id=p_account and j.id=p_job and j.cancellation_notice_id is null and j.operational_contact_id is null
 and (j.meta_followup_lead_id is null or (j.meta_followup_lead_id=m.lead_id and public.icash_meta_followup_current(m.lead_id,'call'))) and not m.voice_paused and public.icash_meta_contact_only(p.account_id,p.screening_id,p.phone) and public.icash_seller_voice_permission_current(p.account_id,p.id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_new_prospect_operation(p_account uuid, p_operation text, p_rate uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare kind text;screen uuid;
begin
 select operation into kind from public.icash_operation_rates where id=p_rate;
 if kind in ('property_search','owner_enrichment','contact_revalidation') then return true;end if;
 if kind='seller_call' then
  select t.screening_id into screen from public.icash_voice_jobs j
   join public.icash_voice_contact_targets t on t.id=coalesce(j.permission_id,j.operational_contact_id) and t.account_id=j.account_id
   where j.account_id=p_account and 'voice:'||j.id=p_operation and t.party='seller'
   and j.callback_id is null and j.sms_source_message_id is null and j.cancellation_notice_id is null;
 elsif kind in ('sms_send','mms_send') then
  select d.screening_id into screen from public.icash_text_messages m
   join public.icash_text_threads t on t.id=m.thread_id and t.account_id=m.account_id
   join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id
   where m.account_id=p_account and 'text:'||m.id=p_operation and t.party='seller' and m.customer_author_id is null;
 else return false;end if;
 if screen is null then return false;end if;
 -- Replies, requested callbacks, customer-written messages, seller submissions
 -- and active contracts keep ordinary credit admission and existing pricing.
 return exists(select 1 from public.icash_screening_jobs s where s.id=screen and s.account_id=p_account and s.snapshot->'sellerRequest' is null)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_deal_files d where d.account_id=p_account and d.screening_id=screen and d.stage<>'draft')
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations c where c.account_id=p_account and c.screening_id=screen and c.party='seller' and c.state='complete' and public.icash_call_has_seller_response(c.result))
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_text_threads t on t.deal_id=d.id and t.account_id=d.account_id
  join public.icash_text_messages m on m.thread_id=t.id and m.account_id=t.account_id
  where d.account_id=p_account and d.screening_id=screen and t.party='seller' and m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and (m.provider_id is not null or m.event_id is not null));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_outgoing_voice_capacity_open()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_capacity_policy where id=1 and credit_state='exhausted') then return false;end if;
 return (
 with slots as materialized (
  select operation_key,agent_id from public.icash_active_voice_slots()
 ), policy as (
  select coalesce((select least(32,workspace_limit) from public.icash_voice_capacity_policy
   where id=1 and verified_at>now()-interval '24 hours'),1) as total_limit
 ), busy as (
  select count(distinct operation_key) total,
   count(distinct operation_key) filter(where operation_key not like 'recorded-reception:%') outgoing from slots
 ), agents as (
  select distinct c.agent_id,least(p.total_limit,coalesce(v.concurrent_limit,1)) agent_limit
  from public.icash_voice_configs c cross join policy p
  left join public.icash_voice_agent_capacity v on v.agent_id=c.agent_id and v.verified_at>now()-interval '24 hours'
  where c.enabled
 ), agent_busy as (
  select agent_id,count(distinct operation_key) total,
   count(distinct operation_key) filter(where operation_key not like 'recorded-reception:%') outgoing
  from slots group by agent_id
 )
 -- Final admission excludes the job's own operation. If such a ready job
 -- already occupies a slot, leave that decision to its existing exact gate.
 select exists(select 1 from slots s join public.icash_voice_jobs j on s.operation_key='voice:'||j.id where j.state='ready')
 or exists(
  select 1 from policy p cross join busy b
  where b.total<p.total_limit and b.outgoing<greatest(1,p.total_limit-2)
   and exists(select 1 from agents a left join agent_busy ab on ab.agent_id=a.agent_id
    where coalesce(ab.total,0)<a.agent_limit
     and (coalesce(ab.outgoing,0)<greatest(1,a.agent_limit-2)
      or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(public.icash_voice_capacity_targets()) t
       where t->>'agentId'=a.agent_id and t->>'branchId' is not null)))
 ));
end $function$

 where b.account_id=p_account and b.operation_key=p_operation and b.rate_id=p_rate

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_research_waiting_on_outreach(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select (case when public.icash_outgoing_voice_capacity_open() then public.icash_outreach_voice_current(p_account) and exists(
  select 1 from (
  select j.account_id,j.id as job_id,p.screening_id,p.phone from public.icash_voice_jobs j
  join public.icash_voice_contact_targets p on p.id=coalesce(j.permission_id,j.operational_contact_id) and p.account_id=j.account_id
  join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=p.screening_id and s.account_id=p.account_id
  where j.account_id=p_account and p.party='seller' and s.state='complete'
   and s.snapshot->'sellerRequest' is null and s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible'
   and (j.state in ('ready','issued') or (j.state='held' and j.outcome='prospecting_budget_held'))
   and j.callback_id is null and j.sms_source_message_id is null and j.cancellation_notice_id is null
   and j.provider_call_sid is null and j.conversation_id is null and j.operation_key is null
   and p.revoked_at is null and p.permission_until>now() and p.dnc_clear
   and j.due_at<=now()
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions x where x.phone=p.phone)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_suppressions x where x.contact_key=p.contact_key)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls x where x.account_id=s.account_id and x.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and x.manual)
   and not exists(select j.account_id,j.id as job_id,p.screening_id,p.phone from public.icash_voice_jobs prior join public.icash_voice_contact_targets pp
    on pp.id=coalesce(prior.permission_id,prior.operational_contact_id) and pp.account_id=prior.account_id
    where prior.account_id=j.account_id and pp.screening_id=p.screening_id and pp.party='seller'
     and (prior.provider_call_sid is not null or prior.conversation_id is not null))
   offset 0
  ) candidate where public.icash_voice_outreach_hours_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.job_id)
   and public.icash_seller_phone_call_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.job_id)
   and public.icash_cold_inventory_available(candidate.account_id,candidate.screening_id,candidate.phone)
 ) else false end) or (public.icash_outreach_sms_current(p_account) and exists(
  select 1 from (
  select t.account_id,t.id as thread_id,s.id as screening_id,t.recipient from public.icash_text_threads t
  join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id
  join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=d.screening_id and s.account_id=d.account_id
  join public.icash_text_messages m on m.thread_id=t.id and m.account_id=t.account_id
  where t.account_id=p_account and t.party='seller' and not t.paused and not t.manual_only and t.retired_at is null
   and s.state='complete' and s.snapshot->'sellerRequest' is null and s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible'
   and coalesce(t.eligibility_until,t.permission_until)>now() and m.direction='outgoing' and m.state='ready'
   and m.customer_author_id is null and m.provider_id is null and m.last_delivery_at is null
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets held
    where held.account_id=m.account_id and held.opener_message_id=m.id
     and ((held.state='held' and held.outcome='held_for_reconciliation')
      or (held.kind='seller_opener' and held.state='consumed' and held.expires_at<now()-interval '5 minutes')))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions x where x.phone=t.recipient)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls x where x.account_id=s.account_id and x.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and x.manual)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_messages prior where prior.account_id=t.account_id and prior.thread_id=t.id and prior.provider_id is not null)
   offset 0
  ) candidate where public.icash_sms_outreach_window_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.thread_id)
   and public.icash_cold_inventory_available(candidate.account_id,candidate.screening_id,candidate.recipient)
 ));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_sms_outreach_window_current(p_account uuid, p_thread uuid, p_clock timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select case when public.icash_outreach_window_open(t.timezone,c.timezone_basis,p_clock) then true
   else public.icash_outreach_active_conversation(p_account,d.screening_id,t.recipient,p_clock) end
  from public.icash_text_threads t join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id
  left join public.icash_operational_contacts c on c.id=t.operational_contact_id and c.account_id=t.account_id and c.channel='sms'
  where t.id=p_thread and t.account_id=p_account and t.retired_at is null),false)

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select to_jsonb(b) from public.icash_voice_credit_bounds b join public.icash_voice_jobs j on b.operation_key='voice:'||j.id and b.account_id=j.account_id
 join public.icash_voice_contact_targets p on p.id=coalesce(j.permission_id,j.operational_contact_id) and p.account_id=j.account_id
 join public.icash_voice_configs c on c.account_id=j.account_id
 where b.account_id=p_account and b.operation_key=p_operation and b.rate_id=p_rate and c.enabled and c.reviewed_until>now()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_outreach_active_conversation(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_phone text, p_clock timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(isfinite(p_clock) and p_phone ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$' and (
  exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_threads t
   join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id
   join public.icash_text_messages m on m.thread_id=t.id and m.account_id=t.account_id
   where t.account_id=p_account and d.screening_id=p_screening and t.recipient=p_phone and t.retired_at is null
    and m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and (m.provider_id is not null or m.event_id is not null)
    and m.created_at between p_clock-interval '24 hours' and p_clock)
  or exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations c
   where c.account_id=p_account and c.screening_id=p_screening
    and c.contact_key=encode(sha256(convert_to(p_phone,'UTF8')),'hex') and c.state='complete'
    and c.completed_at between p_clock-interval '24 hours' and p_clock
    and c.conversation_id is not null and public.icash_call_has_seller_response(c.result))
 ),false)
$function$
